biggest_catch: Every study pays — but you must be told the amount BEFORE you agree, and you have to pass screening for each one; the catalog's '$250' is the top of the official $50–$250+ range, not a guaranteed figure.
catches: Official FAQ: 'Payments often range from $50 to $250 or more' — $250 is the high end of the typical range, not what most studies pay.
You must pass a pre-screener and a recruiter confirmation for every study; not every study will be a fit and that is normal.
Rewards arrive via Tremendous email within 21 days of completion — not instant cash.
Payment is usually a prepaid Visa/Merchant e-card or digital gift card, not always straight cash.
In-person studies require proximity to one of L&E's eleven cities; most users only qualify for online/phone studies.

steps: Go to https://www.leopinions.com/ and sign up for the L&E Opinions panel (free) — fill out your profile with age, job, interests, family, etc.
Browse available studies in your member portal and fill out the pre-screener for ones that fit.
If you match, a recruiter contacts you (email or phone) to confirm details — you are told exactly how much you will be paid and how, before you agree.
Participate in the study (online interview, focus group, survey, or in-person).

Claim your reward: within 21 days of completion you get an email from Tremendous (or check 'My Studies'/'My Wallet' in the portal) to choose a prepaid Visa, digital gift card, or mailed physical card.
timing: Reward email from Tremendous within 21 days after completing the study.
